newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal CPI heading for 30 year lows - Bank chief.
newsitem.headline: Portugal CPI heading for 30 year lows - Bank chief.

text.p: Portugal's inflation, expressed as a year-on-year rate, was heading for levels in the second quarter of the year not seen since the 1960s, central bank governor Antonio de Sousa.
De Sousa told a parliamentary committee that he saw no inflationary pressures in the economy for the current quarter.
Year-on-year inflation slowed to 2.5 percent in March from 2.9 percent in February and analysts have forecast a rate below two percent in April or May.
